headline: Every bottle checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
heroLede: At up to 640 bottles a minute on the Moorabbin warm-fill line, a crooked cap, a wrong label or a bad code goes past faster than anyone can see. Here's what a camera check could look like on your bottling line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every bottle has its cap on, straight and fully closed. A loose cap on a warm-filled bottle means a leak in the pack and a claim from the customer.
labelLede: A sports drink and an iced tea can run in similar bottles and look much the same at line speed, and the wrong label is a wrong ingredient list. The camera checks every bottle carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every bottle. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Cap offcuts, label backing and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a pack.

vocab.alert: Four crooked caps in fifteen minutes. Check the capper.
